title: Logic Apps Run Failures

controlTest.positiveScenario: Inject sample events matching UC-4.2.16 SPL; confirm the search returns rows and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign traffic without matching markers; confirm UC-4.2.16 search returns zero rows.

description: Logic App run failures break automation and integrations. Tracking failures and retries supports debugging and SLA.
value: Detecting logic apps run failures early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Enable diagnostic logging for Logic Apps to Event Hub or Log Analytics. Ingest in Splunk. Alert when run status=Failed. Track retry patterns and correlate with connector/API errors.
visualization: Line chart (runs, failures by workflow), Table (workflow, run, status), Single value (failure rate).
knownFalsePositives: This pattern can surge during change windows, in sandboxes, and when a platform is in maintenance, so we line alerts up with the calendar and take a second look before we call it an incident.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=azure`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` with the modular input for `mscs:azure:diagnostics`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.2.58.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable diagnostic logging for Logic Apps to Event Hub or Log Analytics. Ingest in Splunk. Alert when run status=Failed. Track retry patterns and correlate with connector/API errors.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="mscs:azure:diagnostics" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="mscs:azure:diagnostics" ResourceType="MICROSOFT.LOGIC/WORKFLOWS" status="Failed"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.2.16_logic_apps_run_failures_16"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `mscs:azure:diagnostics` in `index=azure` to detect logic apps run failures. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_2_16_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (runs, failures by workflow), Table (workflow, run, status), Single value (failure rate)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of logic apps run failures so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
